HARLOW & VOSS LEGAL GROUP
551 Ocean View Drive, San Diego, CA 92101

VIA CERTIFIED MAIL

Re: Demand for Payment -- Disputed Charge, Card 4012 8888 8888 1881

To Whom It May Concern:

This firm represents Laura Bennett (SSN on file: 244-08-1357) in connection
with an unauthorized charge on the card referenced above. Despite
repeated attempts to resolve this matter informally, the disputed
amount of $18,500.00 remains unpaid.

Demand is hereby made for full payment within thirty (30) days of the
date of this letter. Failure to remit payment within that period will
result in the filing of a civil action without further notice.

Please direct all correspondence regarding this matter to the
undersigned at l.bennett@example.com or by telephone at
(619) 555-0187.

Sincerely,
Laura Bennett
Senior Litigation Counsel
Harlow & Voss Legal Group
